query: Warning systems will detect imminent hazards and issue protective alerts.
The mobile network will implement cell broadcast to send location-based hazard warnings to all compatible phones in an affected area.
Hazard warnings will reach communities through SMS, sirens, radio and mobile applications.
Flood warnings will be sent to schools and emergency responders so they can evacuate exposed locations.
Climate-sensitive disease and pest surveillance will trigger sector-specific early warnings.
Public warning capabilities will issue timely natural-hazard alerts.
SMS blasts and mass messaging will send hazard warnings to people in affected locations.
Location-based messaging will warn mobile subscribers in hazard-exposed areas.
